# @brand/data

> TanStack DataTable, FilterBar, SearchInput, FacetFilter, ColumnPicker.

Import from `@brand/data`. Part of brand-ui — see the root `llms.txt` for routing.

## Components

- ColumnPicker
- DataTable — TanStack-backed data grid with sorting, filtering, pagination and a render-prop toolbar.
  - avoid: Forking table state into the toolbar — pass the table instance via toolbar={(table) => …}; don't duplicate sorting/filter state.
  - avoid: Hand-rolling virtualization for >50 rows — the DataTable owns it.
  - avoid: Status cells as raw colored text — render a Badge so it reads in every theme.
  - avoid: Decorating a dense table with callouts/hatch — decoration density goes DOWN as information density goes UP.
- FacetFilter
- FilterBar
- SearchInput — Controlled search box that drives a DataTable's global filter.
  - avoid: Keeping uncontrolled internal state — SearchInput is controlled (value + onChange); reflect filter state into the table.
